True beauty begins with how you feel, and our mission is simple: to help you look and feel your best—inside and out. We specialize in subtle, natural-looking enhancements that highlight your features without ever changing who you are. Whether you’re interested in injectables, facials, or advanced aesthetic treatments, our approach blends medical expertise with artistic precision to create results that are fresh, refined, and uniquely you. Get In Touch Our Story Greta Hall Aesthetics began with a simple vision—one nurse, a single vial of Botox®, and a dream Today, we’ve grown into a trusted boutique aesthetics studio and Med Spa in Hingham, Massachusetts , serving clients across Greater Boston, the South Shore (including Cohasset, Scituate, Norwell, Quincy), and Cape Cod. Even as we’ve expanded, our values remain unchanged: Care deeply. Treat people kindly. Focus on natural results. Many of our clients return year after year, not only because of the transformations they see, but because of the way they feel after every visit. Our Philosophy Our philosophy is simple: foster a place where people feel seen, supported, and cared for. Because when you feel good, you live more beautifully.  Personalized Care Every treatment plan is tailored to your unique skin, goals, and lifestyle.  Natural Results We focus on enhancements that refresh and restore—not alter.  Trusted Expertise Our licensed providers combine medical training with aesthetic artistry.  Relationships First We value long-term connections built on trust, compassion, and consistent results. From milestone events to everyday self-care, we offer advanced treatments including Botox®, dermal fillers, facials, microneedling, lasers, vitamins, and peptide therapy —all delivered in a warm, welcoming space. Our Services Meet the Team We are a close-knit team of experienced professionals who share a passion for helping our clients feel confident and cared for. Each team member has specialized training in aesthetics, skincare, and injectables, ensuring you receive the highest level of care at every appointment. Greta Hall, APRN Founder of Greta Hall Skincare Read Bio Greta Hall, owner of Greta Hall Skincare is a registered nurse, certified in injectables through The Aesthetic Institute of Massachusetts. She completed her medical aesthetics training under Dr. Joseph Russo, a Harvard trained and board certified plastic surgeon. Greta continued her education at the Esthetic Skin Institute with certifications in Advanced Facial Treatments and The Science of Skin Rejuvenation. Her attention to detail along with the beauty of facial harmony and rejuvenation is what makes her approach to injectables and skincare incomparable to others. Melissa Sheehan, LE Licensed Esthetician Read Bio Melissa Sheehan graduated from Elizabeth Grady School of Massage Therapy and Esthetics in 2009. She has always had a passion for the beauty and wellness industry. Melissa continues to educate herself in current treatments and is looking forward to making her clients at Greta Hall Skincare look and feel their best! Melissa specializes in facials, diamond glow, collagen induction therapy, laser treatments, tattoo removal, and cool sculpting. As well as eyelash extensions and brow tinting/waxing. Paige Spelman, LE Licensed Esthetician Read Bio Paige Spelman has always had a love for the beauty and esthetic industry from a young age and has been actively working and growing in this field the past 8 years. To ensure clients are getting the latest and greatest in products and services she has continued education and gained numerous post graduate certifications by working under surgeons, medical directors and NPs. She looks forward to sharing her knowledge, skill and passion to help each client feel truly confident and comfortable in their own skin. Meagan Kelley, LE Licensed Esthetician Read Bio Meagan Kelley, a licensed esthetician and our resident wax queen, has been practicing aesthetics for 10 years. She has worked with many different skincare lines and is an expert in products and ingredients. Her passion lies in education and keeping up with the newest treatments to keep her clients looking and feeling their best. Whether it’s luxury facials, waxing, brow or lash enhancements, Meag has you covered! We were so excited when she decided to join our team in the summer of 2025. She has since upgraded her title to Medical Aesthetician after training under our staff on all of our medical-grade treatments! Ellie Grady Practice Manager Read Bio Ellie is passionate about helping clients look and feel their best. With experience in the aesthetics industry and a degree in marketing and business management, she ensures everything at Greta Hall Aesthetics runs smoothly, while keeping the client experience her top priority. Ellie loves building connections and creating a welcoming environment where every visit feels personal and enjoyable. Frequently Asked Questions What makes Greta Hall Aesthetics different from other Med Spas in Hingham, MA and the South Shore? We provide natural-looking results delivered with medical expertise. Our providers focus on personalized care plans, not a one-size-fits-all approach. Our goal is to provide a warm, welcoming and comfortable experience in our boutique setting. Do you serve clients outside of Hingham? Yes. While we’re based in Hingham, many clients travel from Greater Boston, the South Shore (Cohasset, Scituate, Norwell, Quincy), and Cape Cod. Who performs the treatments? All services are performed by licensed professionals. How do I know which treatments are right for me? We always begin with a personalized consultation.
